facts.business: Inspirisys Solutions Limited provides IT services including Infrastructure, Security, Cloud, Software services, System Integration, and Warranty Management Services (WMS).
key_risks: Revenue concentration from two major customers (Rs 16,965 lakhs in FY 2025-26)
Voluntary liquidation of multiple subsidiaries (Japan, Dubai, Singapore branch closure)
Disputed tax demands (Income Tax: Rs 5,540 lakhs, Sales Tax/GST: Rs 17 lakhs, Customs: Rs 236 lakhs, Others: Rs 76 lakhs)
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with related parties are in compliance with Sections 177 and 188 of the Companies Act, 2013, and details disclosed in standalone financial statements as per applicable accounting standards.
